messages:
Maya Chen: Rolling a controlled canary of model-v2 to 10% prod traffic at 23:00 PT (2026-03-18 06:00:00Z). I'm deploy owner. Checklist: [ ] capacity pre-warmed, [ ] KV prefix cache primed, [ ] canary routes + health checks, [ ] rollback toggle ready. Ping when you're green. @Dan @Priya @Leo
Dan Ortiz: Ack — I'll monitor autoscale + latency. Gate: abort if p50 > 120ms for 2 consecutive 1m windows or error rate > 1%. I'll post metrics links when live.
Priya Singh: Infra ✅ pre-warmed 2 nodes in dedicated-east-2. KV cache seeded for top-50 prefixes. Logs forwarded to `prod-log-stream`. Firewall and IAM checks done.
Priya Singh: Deploy command (dry-run):
```
deploy-service --env prod --model model-v2 --canary 10 --pool dedicated-east-2
kubectl rollout status deploy/model-server-v2 -n prod
```
Leo Park: I'll run smoke after canary reaches 10% (T+5m). Smoke script: `./scripts/smoke_checks.sh --target=canary` — checks: generation sanity, latencies, token coverage, embedding dimensionality.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window set for 2026-03-18T06:00:00Z. Canary policy: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 2h unless manual hold.
Maya Chen: Approvals needed: eng-sre + product. Please react with :thumbsup: to approve. Also confirm rollback plan.
Dan Ortiz: :thumbsup: Approve. I'll hold the gate if metrics breach.
Priya Singh: Approve. Infra ready.
Leo Park: Approve and will own rollback run if required.
Maya Chen: Rollback plan (quick): toggle feature-flag `model_serving.variant` back to `v1`, scale down v2, invalidate KV cache if necessary. Runbook snippet:
```
# rollback
ff toggle model_serving.variant=v1
scale down deploy/model-server-v2 --replicas=0
invalidate-kv-cache --prefixes top-50
```
Maya Chen: Criteria to promote to 100%: 30m stable with p50 < 100ms, error rate < 0.5%, no quality regressions in smoke tests. If all green, full cutover at T+2h.
Dan Ortiz: I'll post real-time dashboards in #eng-sre-run during rollout and alert on breaches. Slack alerts -> @oncall.
Leo Park: I have a small smoke checklist I'll paste into runbook once this thread closes. Will kick off smoke and summary.
Maya Chen: Thanks team. Final go/no-go at T-15m in this thread. I'll post a final roll command.
Priya Singh: Standing by. If anyone needs me I'm reachable by DM. :phone: 
Maya Chen: Final: GO from me. Commencing canary at scheduled time unless any objections.
Dan Ortiz: GO from me.
Priya Singh: GO.
Leo Park: GO.
deploy-bot: Canary started at 2026-03-18T06:00:00Z — canary id 20260318-01. Tracking metrics channel #deployments-tracking.
Maya Chen: Logged: owners [Maya Chen, Dan Ortiz, Priya Singh, Leo Park].
